svg.aria-label: Plan shadows at Ithaca, March 21, 10:00 solar time
svg.title: Plan shadows at Ithaca, March 21, 10:00 solar time

g.text: SHADOW SCALE · DRAW ONCE, READ ALL HEIGHTS
Each meter of height casts 1.22 m of shadow (1 / tan ALT).
Take lengths off with dividers; lay them along the bearing.
Shadow of block A (+9 m) falls partly on the roof of block B (+3 m): there the shadow only needs the height difference, 6 m × 1.22.
